# Bayaba Jokbal — a classical-music webzine on one phone

> A classical-music webzine from the Bayaba Content Foundry: piano rendered on-device, reviews and interviews. Built on one Galaxy S21, spoken into a terminal. Part of the aspiration track.

- [Repository](https://github.com/bayaba-1979/bayaba-jokbal)
- [Live site (Korean)](https://bayaba-1979.github.io/bayaba-jokbal/)
- [README](https://github.com/bayaba-1979/bayaba-jokbal#readme)
